tests.note: The one failure is tests/test_core/test_docker.py::test_docker_is_running_and_available, which fails because this sandbox has no Docker daemon. It is unrelated to the added tests and fails without them. The new tests all pass. Line 252 only runs on Python < 3.11 and the sandbox has Python 3.12, so the new tests set the moto.core.utils.PYTHON_311 flag to False (via monkeypatch) to take that branch. Each test runs with the flag both True and False.
